Local models (Ollama http://localhost:11434, LM Studio http://localhost:1234) still documented. Repo active, 'Apache 2.0 (c) 2026 Cline Bot Inc.', no archive/acquisition notice - the Continue/Cursor acquisition lead does not involve Cline. You control where it runs' and 'When you run Cline in your own VPC, inference requests flow directly from your environment to your chosen model providers - Cline doesn't see your code or prompts', plus 'your code is never used to train models' for Cline-managed inference. This strengthens but does not falsify the record's cautious characterization; no compliance certifications shown on the enterprise page, consistent with record. Classification (special=cfg, local-model requirement) stands.

notes: All load-bearing claims re-confirmed. Pricing exact match: Free $0, Pro $20/mo, Max $200/mo, Teams $80/mo + $40/mo per full dev seat, Enterprise custom. Model choice confirmed: Pro includes 'access to OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini frontier models' plus 'Free use of SWE 1.7 and leading open source models' (SWE version now 1.7 - additive; the Devin record itself pins no SWE version, but the sibling Windsurf/Devin Desktop record at index 7 says 'SWE-1.6 (default)' and likely needs updating - flagged for that record's verifier). Deployment boundary re-confirmed exactly as recorded: the Brain is 'a stateless, cloud-based service... always residing in Cognition's Cloud'; Customer Dedicated Deployment means 'Cognition hosts Devin in an auto-scaling, customer-isolated environment within a single-tenant VPC' - vendor-hosted, NOT customer-controlled on-prem; no self-hosted option documented. Training terms confirmed: 'Cognition may use Customer Data for model training purposes' by default; 'If you subscribe to a paid Service Tier, you may opt out of this use'. Sensitive-data prohibition confirmed: 'You agree not to process any medical information or sensitive personal data such as social security numbers, birth dates, passport information, bank account, and credit card numbers'. ZDR defined in terms with safety/abuse carve-outs - product-level, contractual, still vendor cloud; special=no stands. Compliance: security page references 'SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001' as frameworks ('frameworks such as') - record's SOC 2 Type II claim supported; do not add ISO 27001 as a held certification without explicit attestation. Devin Desktop appears across paid plans on the pricing page, corroborating the Windsurf-to-Devin-Desktop merge lead (affects record index 7, outside this slice).
